method: Visual inspection of all three exact native FightEngine captures plus recorded input-driven parallax evidence.
findings: Water Zone: rooftop lattice, two doors, vents and tiled floor stay distinct; near steel edges leave the fighting area clear.
Arcade City: foggy forecourt, concrete overhang, central pole and pavement remain readable. Foreground pillars stay at the margins.
Blood Zone: ribbed doorway, circular platform, dry structural ribs and reddish floor remain legible; no foreground element covers either fighter.
Both unchanged Book of Memories test fighters and weapons remain complete and grounded in each scene, without HUD occlusion.
All three stages draw their exact authored two-plane composition; original left/right input callbacks produce the expected fixed-background and signed-foreground parallax.
limits: Native Canvas does not exercise Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, actual browser keyboard delivery or service workers.
Two static planes and runtime parallax do not constitute original source animation or certify 1:1 artistic fidelity.
No stage hazard, fighter attack, contact, guard or finisher is claimed.
